### Last Respects for Jacob
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/last-respects-jacob
Passage: Genesis 50:7-14
Points:
- God proved faithful to His promise by allowing Joseph to be present at Jacob's death and to bring his body to Canaan.
- Jacob’s burial journey back to the Promised Land served as an early prophetic picture of Israel’s later Exodus from Egypt.
- The journey of Jacob into the place of God's blessing foreshadows the believer's transition from death into resurrection life.
- The death of a believer warrants genuine grief over earthly loss while simultaneously inspiring joy in the certainty of new life in Christ.
- Mourning loved ones who die in faith provides Christians with a meaningful opportunity to reaffirm their trust in the bodily resurrection.
